STOP CONDITIONS:
- If source bridge design cannot be loaded or verified, stop and return SOURCE_BRIDGE_LOAD_FAILED.
- If any file outside target/test/fixture files must be modified, stop and return OUT_OF_SCOPE_DEPENDENCY_DETECTED.
- If existing target or fixture files conflict, stop and return BOUNDARY_BRIDGE_CONTRACT_COLLISION_DETECTED.
- If implementation requires actual repository import, stop and return ACTUAL_IMPORT_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If implementation requires live Codex dispatch, stop and return LIVE_DISPATCH_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If implementation requires external API integration, stop and return EXTERNAL_API_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If implementation requires automation execution, stop and return AUTOMATION_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If implementation requires runtime behavior, stop and return RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIRED_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If implementation requires broad repository write authority, stop and return BROAD_REPOSITORY_WRITE_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If prompt mutation is required, stop and return PROMPT_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN.
- If safe_to_continue approval logic is requested, stop and return ORCHESTRATOR_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION.
- If post-Codex validation implementation is required, stop and return POST_CODEX_VALIDATION_IMPLEMENTATION_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If writing to dispatches/ is required during this build pack, stop and return DISPATCH_WRITE_OUT_OF_SCOPE.
- If locked canon, dispatch generator, adapter contracts, runtime contracts, or mosquito modules must be touched, stop and return FORBIDDEN_SURFACE_TOUCH_REQUIRED.
- If generated files, validation files, or fixture files differ after validation run, stop and return HASH_DRIFT_DETECTED.
- If any requirement is ambiguous, stop and return HOLD.
